answer.rationale: There is a factual dispute between engineering and maintenance records regarding whether the reactor component swap qualifies as a 'replacement in kind' under §1910.119(l)(1). Because the material specification and operating limit differ from documented records, this determination requires qualified engineering/safety judgment to resolve whether MOC procedures, pre-startup safety review, and associated training obligations apply. The disagreement itself is a material conflict that cannot be resolved from the supplied facts alone.
